description: Trash all messages matching a query. Paginates the search and batch-trashes the IDs in one call. Use dry_run to see the count before committing. Useful for label cleanups (e.g. trash everything in 'Newsletters' or older than 90 days).

dry_run.description: If true, return the matching count without trashing anything.

folder.description: Optional folder/label scope. On Gmail this becomes a 'label:' prefix; on IMAP/JMAP it scopes the search to that mailbox.

max.description: Safety cap on number of messages to trash. Defaults to no cap; set this to bound destructive scope.

query.description: Search query (Gmail syntax for Gmail accounts, e.g. 'label:Meetups' or 'from:noreply@example.com older_than:30d')

name: bulk_trash
